import nanosurf

# Initialize COM for Nanosurf
pythoncom.CoInitialize()

# Connect to the AFM system (adjust class if needed)
spm = nanosurf.SPM()  # could also be nanosurf.C3000() etc.
app = spm.application

# Access scan and mode objects
scan = app.Scan
opmode = app.OperatingMode

# Configure scan parameters
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6   # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128         # points per line
scan.Lines = 128          # lines per frame
scan.Scantime = 0.4       # time per line in seconds (0.4 s * 128 lines = 51.2 s total)

# Set a gentle scanning mode – use Tapping (intermittent) mode if available
# The exact enum name may vary; common options are 'Tapping', 'AC', or 'Intermittent'
try:
    # Attempt to set to Tapping mode via enum attribute
    opmode.Mode = opmode.Mode.Tapping
except Exception:
    try:
        # Fallback to alternative name
        opmode.Mode = opmode.Mode.Intermittent
    except Exception as e:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Unable to set tapping mode: {e}")

# Optionally set Z‑controller setpoint and gains for gentle interaction
zctrl = app.ZController
zctrl.SetPoint = 0.5  # modest setpoint (adjust as needed)
# Use moderate PID gains to avoid tip damage
zctrl.PGain = 2000
zctrl.IGain = 1000
zctrl.DGain = 0

# Start the scan and wait for completion
scan.Start()
# Wait until scan finishes (blocking call)
scan.WaitForCompletion()

# Retrieve the saved image path – Nanosurf typically stores the last image in a default folder
# Here we query the Scan object's ImagePath property (if available)
image_path = getattr(scan, 'ImagePath', None)

    timestamp = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')
    image_path = os.path.join(default_dir, f'afm_image_{timestamp}.tif')
    # Save the current topography data to this file
    scan.SaveTopography(image_path)

print(f"AFM scan completed. Image saved at: {image_path}")
"
